title: Polyhedral
summary: POLYHE'DRAL POLYHE'DRON, noun [Gr. many, and side.] 1. In geometry, a body or solid contained under many sides or planes. 2. In optics, a multiplying glass or lens consisting of several plane surfaces

inlines.v: POLYHE'DRAL POLYHE'DRON, noun [Gr. many, and side.] 1. In geometry, a body or solid contained under many sides or planes. 2. In optics, a multiplying glass or lens consisting of several plane surfaces disposed in a convex form.
